data.assumption: “Refund on last month's orders in Chennai” means the total successful refund amount, in minor units, for non-test orders placed in Chennai during August 2026, regardless of when the refund was processed.
data.sql:
SELECT SUM(r.amount_minor) AS value
FROM refunds r
JOIN orders o ON o.order_id = r.order_id
JOIN payment_attempts pa ON pa.attempt_id = r.attempt_id
JOIN showrooms s ON s.showroom_id = o.showroom_id
JOIN cities c ON c.city_id = s.city_id
WHERE o.is_test = FALSE
  AND pa.is_test = FALSE
  AND o.business_date >= DATE '2026-08-01'
  AND o.business_date < DATE '2026-09-01'
  AND c.name = 'Chennai'
  AND r.currency = 'INR'
  AND r.status = 'succeeded'
